title: CPU-Eval: Evaluating Large Language Models for CPU Hardware Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32405v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Benchmarks such as VerilogEval have supported rapid advances in hardware description language (HDL) generation by large language models (LLMs). However, recent HDL-generation systems achieve pass rates above 90% on VerilogEval, leaving limited headroom for revealing further advances. To provide a challenging target for further progress on a practically important hardware-development task, we introduce CPU-Eval, a benchmark of 339 HDL-generation problems constructed from six CPUs. Drawn from practical CPU designs, including families fabricated in silicon, the problems span CPUs from small embedded cores to Linux-capable out-of-order cores and cover diverse CPU functions written in SystemVerilog, Chisel, and SpinalHDL. In each problem, an LLM performs the real CPU-development task of generating HDL. translated_title: CPU-Eval：评估用于CPU硬件代码生成的大语言模型
translated_abstract: VerilogEval等基准测试已经推动了大语言模型（LLM）在硬件描述语言（HDL）生成方面的快速发展。然而，近期的HDL生成系统在VerilogEval上的通过率已超过90%，使得该基准难以进一步揭示模型的进步空间。为了给这一实践上重要的硬件开发任务提供更具挑战性的目标，我们提出了CPU-Eval，这是一个由339个HDL生成问题组成的基准测试，这些问题基于六个CPU构建。这些问题源自实际的CPU设计，包括已在硅片上流片制造的设计系列，涵盖从小型嵌入式核心到可运行Linux的乱序执行核心等各类CPU，并覆盖了用SystemVerilog、Chisel和SpinalHDL编写的多样化CPU功能。在每个问题中，LLM需要执行生成HDL这一真实的CPU开发任务。在七个最先进的大语言模型上，CPU-Eval上的平均pass@1比VerilogEval v2 Spec-to-RTL低45.14个百分点，暴露出了……
tldr: CPU-Eval是一个基于六个真实CPU（含已流片设计）构建的、包含339个HDL生成问题的新基准，其难度远超VerilogEval，使最先进大语言模型的平均pass@1下降45.14个百分点。
en_tdlr: CPU-Eval is a new benchmark of 339 HDL-generation problems built from six real CPUs (including silicon-fabricated designs) that is far more challenging than VerilogEval, reducing state-of-the-art LLMs' mean pass@1 by 45.14 percentage points.
